about: Nevada county and city grant programs, entered by hand from each program's own page. Not a complete list. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: Outside Agency Grant (FY2027/2028)
programs.objectives: Programs that substantially benefit county residents: self-sufficiency, community pride or cohesion, or community infrastructure.
programs.who: Nonprofit organizations, public agencies and government entities.
programs.application: Apply online; instructions on the county's grant page.
programs.award: About $3,000,000 in all, tentative. Minimum request $10,000 (community track) or $25,000 (department track).
programs.deadlines: The FY 2027/2028 round closed October 29, 2026. The county takes applications each year; no next date is published.
